scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: npm run dev:backend & npm run dev:frontend
scripts.demo:reset: npm run db:setup && npm run seed
scripts.demo:reset:sqlite: npm run db:setup:sqlite && npm run seed
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run db:setup && npm run seed
scripts.db:setup: cd backend && npx prisma db push
scripts.db:setup:sqlite: cd backend && npx prisma db push --schema prisma/schema.sqlite.prisma && npx prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.sqlite.prisma
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:concurrency: npm run demo:reset && npm --prefix backend run test:concurrency
scripts.test:concurrency:sqlite: npm run demo:reset:sqlite && npm --prefix backend run test:concurrency
scripts.eval: npm run demo:reset && cd backend && npm run eval
scripts.eval:sqlite: npm run demo:reset:sqlite && cd backend && npm run eval
scripts.eval:holdout: npm run demo:reset && npm --prefix backend run eval:holdout
scripts.eval:holdout:sqlite: npm run demo:reset:sqlite && npm --prefix backend run eval:holdout
